note: Bank-acquired properties for sale in Batangas, refreshed monthly by .github/workflows/comparables-monthly.yml. Replaced in full each run: properties no longer listed are removed. Prices are the bank's advertised/selling prices ('as is, where is'), not closed sales. Personal data (sales officers) is never collected.

sources.label: Security Bank repossessed assets
sources.note: Answers HTTP 403 to automated requests, so it is not fetched (we do not get around blocks). A person may enter its table as inbox/securitybank.rows.json.

sources.label: SSS housing acquired assets
sources.note: Monthly PDF with a new address each month and about one Batangas property, so it is not fetched; enter it as inbox/sss.rows.json when wanted.
